note: Open: the bands call `volume_spike` acceptable, because volume rose by three quarters week on week. The call is that it is wrong here: the rise is from 80 messages to 140 on a domain seven years old with a grade of high, no complaints, no bounces and well-opened mail, which is ordinary correspondence, and sixty more messages is not a change any receiver measures. A spike warning would have this client spreading out or holding back everyday mail to guard against nothing; at real volume the bands' answer would stand. General practice; the bulk-sender requirements published by Google and by Yahoo are written for bulk senders, which this is not.
